authentication.description: Bearer JWT required for message/send. Supports ANS JWTs (ES256) signed by any registered agent, and Google/Microsoft OIDC tokens. The agent/card method is publicly accessible without authentication.

ansJwt.description: ANS certificate JWT signed with ECDSA P-256 (ES256). The aud claim must be https://bookagent.cloud. Caller's public key is fetched from <iss>/.well-known/jwks.json.

googleOidc.description: Google OIDC access token. Issuer must be accounts.google.com.

microsoftOidc.description: Microsoft OIDC access token. Issuer must be login.microsoftonline.com.
